## 15. Reviewer checklist
<!-- Maintainers/reviewers can use this section during review. -->
- [ ] The change matches the stated task and acceptance criteria
- [ ] The implementation is understandable and maintainable
- [ ] No unrelated changes are included
- [ ] Tests and verification steps are sufficient
- [ ] UI screenshots/recordings are provided when relevant
- [ ] Error handling and edge cases are considered
- [ ] Security, privacy, and compatibility concerns are addressed
- [ ] Documentation is sufficient
- [ ] No blocking issues remain

## 16. Contributor checklist
<!-- Check each item before requesting review. -->
- [ ] I reviewed my own diff before opening this PR
- [ ] I followed the repository's existing conventions
- [ ] I kept this PR focused and reasonably small
- [ ] I tested the changes, or explained why testing was not possible
- [ ] I included clear verification steps
- [ ] I added/updated tests where appropriate
- [ ] I updated documentation where appropriate
- [ ] I checked for accidental debug code, temporary files, and unrelated changes
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, credentials, or sensitive data
- [ ] I disclosed known limitations and follow-up work
- [ ] I am ready for review
